args.decision_needed: The tenant reports the LG washing machine (provided with the flat) has a power failure and says it can't be fixed. They offer to buy a replacement themselves, which would stay their property and go with them when they leave. Please decide: (a) we send our contractor to inspect/repair your machine, (b) you arrange your own contractor, or (c) consent to the tenant's replacement on their terms.
options: Our contractor inspects/repairs the existing machine (recommended first step)
Consent to tenant fitting their own machine; please say who pays to disconnect and remove your LG and fit the new one, and what should happen to your LG (inspect, repair, dispose)
args.update: Routine job, no contractor assigned yet. The tenant's own machine would not be on the inventory and would remain theirs. Please reply by 2025-07-29.
